schedules_timeline_order_valid.name: schedules_timeline_order_valid
schedules_timeline_order_valid.value: julianday("schedules"."start_date") >= (julianday("schedules"."start_date") - (COALESCE("schedules"."registration_close_minutes_before", 0) / 1440.0)) AND (julianday("schedules"."start_date") - (COALESCE("schedules"."registration_close_minutes_before", 0) / 1440.0)) >= (CASE WHEN "schedules"."registration_open_minutes_before" IS NULL THEN julianday("schedules"."created_at") ELSE julianday("schedules"."start_date") - ("schedules"."registration_open_minutes_before" / 1440.0) END) AND (CASE WHEN "schedules"."registration_open_minutes_before" IS NULL THEN julianday("schedules"."created_at") ELSE julianday("schedules"."start_date") - ("schedules"."registration_open_minutes_before" / 1440.0) END) >= (CASE WHEN "schedules"."publication_minutes_before" IS NULL THEN julianday("schedules"."created_at") ELSE julianday("schedules"."start_date") - ("schedules"."publication_minutes_before" / 1440.0) END) AND (CASE WHEN "schedules"."publication_minutes_before" IS NULL THEN julianday("schedules"."created_at") ELSE julianday("schedules"."start_date") - ("schedules"."publication_minutes_before" / 1440.0) END) >= julianday("schedules"."created_at")

users_centers_phone_e164.name: users_centers_phone_e164
users_centers_phone_e164.value: LENGTH(CASE WHEN SUBSTR("users_centers"."phone_number", 1, 1) = '+' THEN SUBSTR("users_centers"."phone_number", 2) ELSE "users_centers"."phone_number" END) BETWEEN 7 AND 15 AND NOT ((CASE WHEN SUBSTR("users_centers"."phone_number", 1, 1) = '+' THEN SUBSTR("users_centers"."phone_number", 2) ELSE "users_centers"."phone_number" END) GLOB '*[^0-9]*')
